modules.title: All Types of Health Institutions — Minimum Requirements
modules.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
modules.notes: Enforcement/governance context, verbatim-faithful: 'Failure to display HPA Certificate will result in a fine' (p16). PLEASE NOTE passage (pp18-19): facilities with the following shortfalls shall be registered while they attend to the shortfalls within a week as the items are not critical and will not affect the functioning of the facilities — bin liners; liquid soap and appropriate non-usable hand drying facilities; proof of medical waste disposal; screens and footstools (pp18-19). Where facilities are considered grossly inadequate (failing to meet the minimum requirements), the Health Institution shall be closed (p19). For Routine Inspections, practitioners are usually given a month in which to attend to the noted shortfalls (p19). The PLEASE NOTE obligation 'Practitioners shall not to open their premises until they have been registered with the Health Professions Authority' (p18) is an inspectable obligation and is captured as item ALL-052.

items.requirement: A health practitioner must only practice in registered Health Institutions (Section 99 of the Health Professions Act – Chapter 27:19 of 2000).

items.requirement: A health practitioner must display the HPA licence and relevant professional council practising certificates in a conspicuous position (Section 106 (i) of the Health Professions Act – Chapter 27:19 of 2000).

modules.title: Medical Consulting Rooms — Minimum Requirements
modules.notes: Cross-reference (p20): 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum Requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' — apply MOD-ALL-HEALTH-INSTITUTIONS in addition to this module; not restated as items here. The Treatment room heading is marked '(optional)' with the note 'Depending with the practice, this may be incorporated into the consulting room' (p21); its items apply where a treatment room is provided.

items.requirement: Walls must be brought to a smooth, impervious and washable finish.

measurement.expected: 2.6 m to 3 m off the floor

items.requirement: Adequate ventilation and lighting provided by both natural and artificial means.
Desk, doctor's chair and 2 chairs (for patient and a relative). Chairs must be covered with washable material.
Suitable linen and proper laundry arrangements and disinfections.
Foot operated receptacle with self-closing devices, with plastic lining for ease of cleaning and infection control purposes.

items.reviewReason: Manual reads 'Hydrocortisone x vials' — the number of vials is not stated (compare '50% Dextrose x 2 vials'); required quantity is unclear.

items.requirement: Oxygen cylinder with connectors, tubing and mask.
Oropharyngial airways (3 sizes - infants, paediatrics, adults).
Sharps box (for those without treatment room).
items.applicability: for practices without a treatment room

items.requirement: Equipment to have (see grouped component items).
items.reviewReason: The equipment list under MEDICAL consulting rooms includes optometry/ophthalmic-specific instruments ('Trial frame and trial set/phoroptor', 'Slit lamp', 'Vertometer/lensmeter', 'Tonometer', 'Retinoscope and ophthalmoscope') that appear misplaced for a general medical consulting room; the manual states them here nonetheless, and the list closes with 'Other diagnostic equipment suitable for the practice'.

items.requirement: Other diagnostic equipment suitable for the practice.
Reference books - EDLIZ and ARV Guidelines, BNF, TB Manuals; electronic books are acceptable.
Adequate ventilation and lighting provided by both natural and artificial means.
